title: DPLAN: Minimal Connectivity to Floorplan Generation
summary: Automated floor plan generation is an important problem in computational architectural design. The goal is to construct a floor plan from user-defined room numbers and door requirements. The user specifies which rooms must share a door and which rooms must not be adjacent. However, these requirements do not determine the exact placement or shape of the rooms. The task is therefore to arrange the rooms in a single floor plan so that all required door connections are satisfied and no rooms overlap.
